description: This file contains unit tests for request context propagation and thread-hopping behavior in Orleans-based distributed system. It includes tests for activity ID propagation, request context setting, and thread context preservation across asynchronous calls and grain interactions.

classes.name: RequestContextTests_Silo
classes.description: Contains multiple unit tests verifying request context propagation, activity ID handling, and thread context preservation in Orleans grains and tasks.

classes.name: Halo_RequestContextTests
classes.description: Tests for request context maintenance across thread hopping using Task.Run in a distributed Orleans environment.

classes.name: Halo_CallContextTests
classes.description: Tests for call context (AsyncLocal) preservation across thread hopping in asynchronous operations.

classes.name: RequestContextGrainObserver
classes.description: An observer class for testing state change notifications within request context.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up request context state after tests.

methods.description: Tests simple propagation of activity ID across grain call.

methods.name: RequestContext_AC_Test1

methods.name: RequestContext_Task_Test1
methods.description: Tests request context propagation with various asynchronous delay patterns.

methods.name: RequestContext_Task_TestRequestContext
methods.description: Checks the correctness of request context data within a grain.

methods.name: RequestContext_ActivityId_RC_Set_E2E
methods.description: Tests propagation of activity ID set via RequestContext across grain calls.

methods.description: Tests activity ID propagation when set via CallContext (ReentrancyId).

methods.name: RequestContext_ActivityId_CM_E2E_ViaProxy
methods.description: Tests activity ID propagation via proxy grain calls.

methods.description: Verifies behavior when no activity ID is set in request context.
